mapper.select: SELECT FROM training_session WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM training_session WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED') LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM training_question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY position_index
SELECT FROM training_question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(exposure_kind='AUTHORED'),0) AS authored_count, COALESCE(SUM(exposure_kind='REFERENCE_VIEW'),0) AS reference_view_count,MAX(created_at) AS last_exposure_at, COALESCE(SUM(exposure_kind='EVALUATION_ACCESS'),0) AS evaluation_access_count FROM question_exposure WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND question_id=#{sourceQuestionId}
SELECT id,owner_id,session_id,board_id,board_revision,created_at FROM training_board_import WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND id=#{importId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM training_draft_knowledge_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE training_session SET event_count=event_count+1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND event_count=#{expectedCount} AND event_count < 2000

UPDATE training_session SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,generation=generation+1,material_access=#{materialAccess}, observation_at=#{observationAt},pause_started_at=#{pauseStartedAt},started_at=#{startedAt},ended_at=#{endedAt}, end_checklist_json=#{endChecklistJson},updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected} AND generation < 9007199254740991
UPDATE training_session SET material_access=TRUE,assistance_event_sequence=#{sequence},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
UPDATE training_question SET exposure_json=#{exposureJson} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND id=#{questionId}
UPDATE training_question SET draft_json=#{draftJson},draft_saved_at=#{savedAt},revision=revision+1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
UPDATE training_question SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
